title: Ask to Learn: Query-Based Collaborative Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning is fundamentally limited by the coverage of the available data, while collecting additional trajectories through online exploration may be costly, unsafe, or infeasible. We study whether this limitation can be overcome without directly interacting with the underlying environment. Motivated by practical settings such as collaborator-mediated simulation, where a collaborator can provide information complementary to the offline data, we introduce query-based collaborative reinforcement learning to study how to acquire this information efficiently. The learner starts with a fixed offline dataset and adaptively queries state-time pairs; the collaborator samples an action according to a fixed, possibly suboptimal policy, and the simulator returns the corresponding reward and next state. translated_title: 问而学：基于查询的协作强化学习
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习从根本上受限于可用数据的覆盖范围，而通过在线探索收集额外轨迹可能代价高昂、不安全或不可行。我们研究能否在不与底层环境直接交互的情况下克服这一局限。受协作者中介模拟等实际场景的启发——其中协作者可以提供与离线数据互补的信息——我们提出了基于查询的协作强化学习，以研究如何高效地获取这些信息。学习者从一个固定的离线数据集出发，自适应地查询状态-时间对；协作者根据一个固定的、可能是次优的策略采样动作，模拟器返回相应的奖励和下一状态。对于有限视界的表格型问题，我们推导了关于额外查询次数的实例依赖的信息论下界……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于查询的协作强化学习新框架，使仅有离线数据的学习者无需直接与环境交互，即可通过自适应地向持有互补信息的协作者查询状态-时间对来突破离线数据覆盖范围的限制，并针对有限视界表格型问题给出了所需查询次数的实例依赖信息论下界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces query-based collaborative reinforcement learning, where a learner holding only offline data can overcome data coverage limitations without directly interacting with the environment by adaptively querying a collaborator for state-time pairs, and establishes instance-dependent information-theoretic lower bounds on the required number of queries for finite-horizon tabular problems.
